navigationLaw: Jake proves Ethan is deliberately corrupting routes by comparing a copied route against family chart habits. No supernatural inference and no mandatory optional Highmoore line.

actors.name: C06_03_FamilyChart
actors.title: Harlow family chart habits
actors.body: Marc's annotations favor consistent safety margins and repeatable tidal corrections. Jake knows the pattern well enough to recognize deliberate deviations.

actors.name: C06_03_EthanCopy
actors.title: Ethan's copied route
actors.body: Tiny bearing errors recur where only another Harlow would know they are wrong. Each error bends a pursuer away from danger while remaining plausible to Draven.

actors.name: C06_03_CrewWitness
actors.text: He is not guiding Draven cleanly. He is surviving long enough to leave you a road back to him.

actors.name: C06_03_Proof
actors.title: Deliberate false bearings
actors.body: The errors form a consistent protective pattern. Ethan is resisting from inside the Armada's navigation chain.
